newsitem.title: USA: Deluxe ends bidding for two of its units.
newsitem.headline: Deluxe ends bidding for two of its units.

text.p: Deluxe Corp said Monday it is suspending the bidding process that has been underway for two Deluxe Direct businesses, Current Social Expressions and PaperDirect Inc.

"We still intend to sell these businesses, but we're not happy with the results of our bidding process to date and are under no pressure to give them away in any sort of fire sale," J.A. Blanchard, chairman, said in a statement.
In 1996, he added, Deluxe improved the profitability of the units, determined their fair market value and took a goodwill charge of $111.9 million at year-end.
"We'll continue to operate them as profitable contributors to our overall performance until we receive reasonable offers," Blanchard said.
He added that Current Social Expressions and PaperDirect historically have been more profitable in the second half of the year.
"As a result, we don't anticipate any negative impact on our operating profit target by delaying the sale of these two units," he said.
